name: Cilium Evidence Boundary
summary: Shared evidence and safety contract for the Cilium board: claim classes, command classification by real behavior, Hubble flow-telemetry limits, the verdict vocabulary, and the handoff of verified findings to the existing Jira and Confluence authoring skills. Loaded first by every Cilium specialist; never answers a domain question alone.
security_notes: Static review only. Classifies cilium connectivity test as an active diagnostic, the upgrade preflight as a mutation and cilium sysdump as privileged, sensitive collection; never requests diagnostic bundles. An unobserved flow is never evidence that traffic did not occur.
